name: TA-8-ruggedness
why: A single sharp spike (and a few smaller, asymmetric perturbations around it) sits directly on the straight row-3 route between start and end, producing strongly divergent unit normals near it (high VRM) while the surrounding rows stay comparatively flat. A strict maxRuggedness excludes the rough band from the eligible network, forcing a detour; an unset one (null) does not.
